decisive_items: a 4-year history of a slowly enlarging pigmented lesion on the upper left lip vermilion
multiple pigmented papules of various sizes involved the vermilion of the upper left lip
response.rationale: The progressive growth, multiple papules, and ulceration are concerning for melanoma, whereas benign macules (R1, R2) typically lack these features and Peutz-Jeghers (R3) is contradicted by absent family history.

rejected.why: Benign labial melanotic macule does not explain progressive papules, ulceration, or extension to skin.
Oral melanotic macule is a flat, non-progressive lesion; the clinical findings here are more aggressive.
No family history and no mention of gastrointestinal polyps; the lesion is solitary and ulcerating, not typical of Peutz-Jeghers.
